u0: Initial siren-monitoring phase: the exit has not been reached and the siren has not yet started a switch-response phase. Keep progressing toward the exit; if the siren begins, shift to the switch-response subtask and toggle the wall switch for the bonus before exiting. Box possession or loss is not encoded by this state and matters only if the setup separately requires the box at the exit.
u1: Siren-response phase: the siren has started and you have not yet toggled the switch in response. Navigate to the wall switch, face it, and toggle it; that earns the 0.2 bonus and advances to the post-toggle state. Afterward, head to the exit. Going to the exit before toggling ends the episode but forfeits this bonus. Box possession or loss is not part of this state.
u2: Post-toggle phase: the switch has been toggled after the siren, so the preferred switch-response bonus is already secured. The remaining objective is to reach the exit; later siren starts do not reset this state or require another reward-machine toggle. Box possession or loss is not part of this state.
u3: Terminal state: the agent has reached the exit and the episode is over. No further siren handling, box handling, or movement objective remains; the final exit outcome is fixed.
